panelShellPanel.description: Floating button satellite and its tooltip: opens the Voyager panel on the page. Keep "Voyager" untranslated.

panelShellHide.description: Tooltip of the floating button satellite that hides the floating button

panelShellHideButton.description: Accessible name of the satellite that hides Voyager's floating button

panelShellUndo.description: Toast button that shows the floating button again

panelShellManagePrompts.description: Last-but-one entry of the slash (/) prompt menu: opens the Prompt Manager

panelShellOpenPanel.description: Last entry of the slash (/) prompt menu: opens the Voyager panel. Keep "Voyager" untranslated.
